title: Upwork Scraper PRO - Input
description: Clone of blackfalcondata/upwork-scraper - Enhanced with AI scoring & more filters

query.title: 🔍 Search Term(s)
query.description: Job search keywords. Leave empty to browse all jobs. Supports array string like ["python", "react"] for batch search.

searchUrl.title: 🔗 Search URL (Paste Mode)
searchUrl.description: Paste full Upwork search URL https://www.upwork.com/nx/search/jobs/?q=... Filters auto-parsed. Overrides query if provided.

startUrls.title: 🔗 Multiple Search URLs
startUrls.description: Multiple Upwork search URLs - each searched separately, results deduped. Powerful for covering multiple niches in one run.

category.title: 📁 Category
category.description: Upwork category name (e.g. Web Development) or array of them

location.title: 🌍 Client Location (include)
location.description: Countries, regions, or ISO codes. Accepts: United States, US, europe, north_america

budget.title: 💰 Fixed-Price Budget
budget.description: Filter fixed-price jobs by amount range

hourlyRate.title: ⏱️ Hourly Rate Range
hourlyRate.description: Filter hourly jobs by rate (USD/hr). Format min-max, open with dash e.g. 50-

clientHires.title: 📋 Client Hiring History
clientHires.description: Filter by how many freelancers client hired

maxAgeMinutes.title: ⏰ Max Age (minutes)
maxAgeMinutes.description: Only jobs posted within last N minutes. 0 = no limit. Perfect for scheduled runs.

minClientTotalSpent.title: 💵 Min Client Total Spent (USD)
minClientTotalSpent.description: PRO FILTER: Only clients who spent at least this much. e.g. 10000 = $10k+ premium clients only

includeKeywords.title: 📝 Include Keywords (AND/OR)
includeKeywords.description: Require keywords in title/description/skills. {keywords:["React"], matchTitle:true, matchDescription:true, matchSkills:true}

excludeKeywords.title: 🚫 Exclude Keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Exclude jobs containing keywords. Same shape as includeKeywords

customFilters.title: 🔧 Custom Filters (advanced)
customFilters.description: Array of {field, op, value}. op: includes|notIncludes|equals|notEquals|gt|gte|lt|lte. e.g. [{"field":"clientCountry","op":"equals","value":"United States"}]

maxResults.title: 💯 Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum total results. 0 = unlimited. Upwork caps ~5050 per query.

descriptionMaxLength.title: ✂️ Description Max Length
descriptionMaxLength.description: Truncate description to N chars. 0 = full text. Set 2000 to save tokens.

compact.title: 📦 Compact Output (for AI/MCP)
compact.description: Core fields only - lightweight for LLMs

excludeEmptyFields.title: 🧹 Exclude Empty Fields
excludeEmptyFields.description: Drop null/empty fields for smaller payload

incrementalMode.title: ♻️ Incremental Mode
incrementalMode.description: Only output new/changed jobs since last run. Saves 80-95% cost on scheduled runs!

stateKey.title: 🔑 State Key
stateKey.description: Stable identifier for tracked search. Auto-derived from query if empty.

skipReposts.title: 🚫 Skip Reposts
skipReposts.description: In incremental mode, skip reposts of expired jobs

emitUnchanged.title: 🔄 Emit Unchanged
emitUnchanged.description: Also emit unchanged listings in incremental mode

enrichDetails.title: 💎 Enrich With Details (requires sessionToken)
enrichDetails.description: Fetch authenticated detail page per job to unlock 30+ extra fields. Billed per enriched job if enabled in future.

sessionToken.title: 🔐 Upwork Session Token
sessionToken.description: Bearer token from logged-in Upwork session (DevTools > Network > authorization header, value like oauth2v2_int_...). Treat as password!

detailConcurrency.title: ⚙️ Detail Fetch Concurrency
detailConcurrency.description: Parallel requests when enriching. 5 conservative, 10-20 faster.

enableAIScoring.title: 🤖 Enable AI Lead Scoring (PRO - Extra Powerful)
enableAIScoring.description: NEW: Adds customJobScore, competitionScore, clientTier, estimatedConnects, hireRate. Helps pick best leads instantly without spending Connects.

proxyConfiguration.title: 🌐 Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Leave default for best reliability. Uses Apify Proxy.

telegramChatId.title: 💬 Telegram Chat ID
telegramChatId.description: Chat or channel ID (starts with -100 for channels)

notifyOnlyChanges.title: 🔔 Notify Only New/Updated
notifyOnlyChanges.description: In incremental mode, only notify for NEW/UPDATED

jinaApiKey.title: Jina API Key
jinaApiKey.description: Optional Jina AI Reader API key for Cloudflare bypass via https://r.jina.ai/ + browser engine. Get free at https://jina.ai/reader
